messages:
maria: Hey docs team — noticed the Connection playbook anchors broke after #4523. A couple of links in the Private/VPC quickstart now 404. Can someone patch the anchors and add a tiny, copy-paste friendly example for sealed-network egress?

ajay: I saw that too. The headings changed during the TOC refactor (old: #vpc-egress, new: #vpc-egress-playbook). I can open a small PR to add anchor aliases + redirect notes.

sophia: Can we also include a minimal nft/iptables snippet and a one-line SDK example for `kms.transport` override for airgapped installs? Users keep pinging for a concrete example.

maria: Yes. Ideally both `nftables` and an `iptables` fallback, plus a short HSM note about file permissions on pkcs11 sockets.

ajay: Working on it. Draft PR will: 1) add HTML anchor aliases, 2) append an "Egress playbook" subsection under Private quickstart, 3) include a tiny HSM note.

sophia: Here's the compact nftables example I recommend (for the docs snippet):
```bash
# nftables - minimal NAT for sealed networks
nft add table ip nat
nft 'add chain ip nat POSTROUTING { type nat hook postrouting priority 100; }'
nft add rule ip nat POSTROUTING oifname "eth0" masquerade
```

kevin: 👌 Also add this iptables line for folks still on legacy setups: `iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE` — small note about double-NAT when running behind cloud NATs.

maria: For the SDK/KMS transport, accept this minimal YAML + python example for the quickstart: 
```yaml
# installer config (example)
kms:
  transport: unix
  socket_path: /var/run/kms.sock
```
```python
# python SDK one-liner for doc users
from redwood_sdk import Client
client = Client(kms_transport="unix", kms_socket="/var/run/kms.sock")
```

ajay: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 — adds anchors, playbook, nft/iptables examples, and a short HSM file-permissions checklist. PTAL.

docbot: link-checker: 3 broken links detected in /private/vpc/quickstart.md — these are addressed in PR 789.

sophia: Tiny editorial request: add an explanation about when to use `unix` vs `tcp` transport (airgapped vs managed), one sentence each. I added the copy to the PR.

ajay: Added that. Also called out that PKCS11 sockets must be readable by the installer user (example: `chown kore:installer /var/run/pkcs11.sock && chmod 660 /var/run/pkcs11.sock`).

kevin: CI ran linkcheck and static lint — caught a missing trailing slash on `/private` anchor, fixed in the branch.

sophia: Can we include a micro-migration note in the Private migration guide: "If you rely on direct heading links, prefer anchor aliases or internal redirects to avoid breakage during refactors" — I added a 2-line paragraph in the PR.

maria: Perfect. After merge, please drop the preview URL here and I'll sanity-check the quickstart anchors on the preview site.

docbot: netlify-preview: https://deploy-preview-789--docs.redwood.ai

maria: Preview looks good, anchors resolve, snippets render correctly, and code blocks have line-highlighting. LGTM from me.

kevin: Squashed + merged. Closing this thread — thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
